scope: Completed same-input ordinary CPU/F32 Moebius image API pair, one first image and three warm images per arm; no observer capture or new original-framework run.
decision: Keep CPU depthwise default off and outside the main recommended Moebius preset. Preserve it as an optional experimental path until a stable end-to-end benefit is measured. Do not integrate the separately screened 128 MiB workspace policy.

comparison_design.baseline: Persistent graph, GEMM layout, relative-lambda and unpadded local-lambda reassociation; depthwise and hash acceleration disabled.
comparison_design.candidate: The same executable, sources, fixture and graph settings, enabling only CPU depthwise and required verified SHA-NI model hashing.

timings_ms.median_interpretation: The candidate median is slower in this pair. Neither the lower candidate mean nor its best sample supports a speedup claim.
timings_ms.load_observation: One load/validation observation per arm: 4972.515752 to 1277.329965 ms. The controller prehashes the files, so this is not a physical cold-disk benchmark or an isolated SHA timing measurement.
timings_ms.cold_interpretation: First-image time includes lazy graph preparation/allocation and computation. Candidate 392586.9972 ms is retained without exclusion; its numerical output is exact.

memory.scope: RUSAGE_CHILDREN high-water mark includes the small pre-run ps child; successful model runs dominate it.

actual_native_comparison.qualification: native implementation agreement only, not original-model or perceptual quality

native_image_comparison.scope: Native implementation agreement on one photograph; warm payload equality is additionally checked within the native benchmark, whose four output hashes are retained in each process receipt.

executed_work.note: Logical graph nodes, not individual per-worker callback invocations. All finalized profiles report CPU/F32.

baseline.scope: Actual verified model hashing and full input-block counts only; no inference or hardware-speed qualification.

candidate.scope: Actual verified model hashing and full input-block counts only; no inference or hardware-speed qualification.

resource_caveats: Both arms overlap unrelated compilation and shared host activity; all samples and before/after resource snapshots are preserved. No sample is removed and no causal timing attribution is claimed.
Baseline before snapshot records rustc at 131% CPU and 1173504 KiB RSS; after snapshot records 98.2% and 1585812 KiB. Its 266263.2941 ms third warm sample is retained.
The baseline file named midrun-resources-1.json was captured at 14:05:54.752449 UTC, after the process after-snapshot at 14:05:48.659936 UTC. It is post-run evidence, not a midpoint sample.

Candidate before snapshot records rustc at 98.8% CPU and 2009568 KiB RSS; after snapshot records 101% and 1259216 KiB. Its sidecar at 14:14:41.641187 UTC was captured during execution and shows the native process at 594% CPU.
No CUDA or Metal hardware was present. The result does not establish portable backend performance.

source_review_during_slow_first_image.scope: Bounded source-only inspection; no production changes or extra native tests resulted.
source_review_during_slow_first_image.accumulation: Custom and pinned direct WHCN depthwise paths accumulate F32 from positive zero in ky/kx order and skip identical padded taps. Custom interiors expose independent x lanes; the pinned explicit CWHN SIMD path applies to a different layout. Both translation units use -O3 -march=native without fast-math; emitted vector/FMA behavior was not inspected.
source_review_during_slow_first_image.subnormals: Neither path explicitly changes FTZ/DAZ or tests/clamps subnormals. No explicit candidate-only subnormal branch was found; runtime floating-point mode or a timing cause was not measured.
source_review_during_slow_first_image.partition: Both request all configured ggml workers. Custom partitions H*C*B rows, evenly divisible by eight for the real batch-two Moebius shapes. Widths 16/32/64 use one interior block and two border pixels.
source_review_during_slow_first_image.allocation: Pinned ggml_op_can_inplace excludes GGML_OP_CUSTOM; ggml_custom_4d creates a fresh tensor, while the unused ggml_custom_inplace constructor explicitly creates a view. Automatic same-shape input reuse therefore does not apply to this custom node.
source_review_during_slow_first_image.conclusion: No concrete dispatch, accumulator or automatic in-place alias defect was found. This excludes those particular source-level hypotheses without explaining the slow first image.
